# RunHuddle 0.11.2 preview
Correct the remaining narrow-window clipping that 0.11.1 did not resolve.
- Replace nested native split views with columns calculated from the current available width. - Sidebar and session details stay within the window as it narrows. Below the two-column breakpoint, details replace the list; close details to return to the list. - The sidebar can still be hidden from the toolbar. Details can be closed in every filter. - Minimum window width is 760 points. Column sizing is automatic rather than manually draggable.
Validation: built successfully and rendered the production layout containers with representative session content at 1320 → 900 → 760 → 1320 points in the same offscreen window. Sidebar labels and wrapped detail text remain within bounds. This fixture is reproducible with `bash scripts/render-workspace-resize.sh`. Live multi-monitor interaction remains unverified.
